# What the bench and schema workflows' DuckLake bootstrap imports: duckdb, at the release
# test/duckdb_versions.json lists last (check_ci_cache_pins.py keeps them equal), and minio.
#
# Every package and dependency at an exact version, with the SHA-256 of each file PyPI serves
# for it, installed as
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r .github/requirements/ducklake_bootstrap.txt
# so pip installs these files and nothing else. To change it, regenerate the whole file:
#   printf 'duckdb==2.0.0\nminio==7.2.20\n' | uv pip compile - --universal --generate-hashes --no-header \
#     --no-annotate --python-version 3.12 --exclude-newer <a date two weeks back>
# (--exclude-newer keeps each dependency to a release at least two weeks old.)
